text.p: Holding company Acoje Holdings Inc said on Thursday its board has agreed to issue 49.5 billion new shares to three investors in exchange for membership certificates in a sports club in Makati business district.

Acoje said ATC Securities Inc, Gem Communications Holdings Corp and Anselmo Trinidad Jr, who are existing shareholders of the company, will give membership certificates of Metropolitan Club Inc worth 316.550 million pesos.
Metropolitan Club is located in a prime property in Manila and the club has said it plans to develop the land.

Earlier on Thursday, the Philippine Stock Exchange froze the share price of Acoje after it gained eight centavos, or 48.48 percent, to 25 centavos. The bourse automatically freezes a share price if it rises by close to 50 percent.
Traders said the rise in its share price was due to talk of a buy-in by a foreign partner but this was denied by a company official. - Manila newsroom 63 2 8418938 Fax 8176267
